name: Catalyst Monitor

steps.title: List the catalysts
steps.detail: Earnings, product events, regulatory dates, competitor prints, macro releases — everything dated that touches the thesis.

steps.title: Map leading indicators
steps.detail: What data leaks ahead of each catalyst? Channel checks, web data, peer results, pre-announcements.

steps.title: Set the triggers
steps.detail: For each catalyst: what outcome confirms, what kills, and what you’ll DO in each case. Decide now, not in the moment.

steps.title: Build the calendar
steps.detail: Dated list with owner, source and check cadence.

steps.title: Schedule the reviews
steps.detail: A thesis unreviewed for a quarter is a stale thesis. Fix the cadence.

steps.title: Delegate 1
steps.detail: Compiling dated events from IR calendars and filings

steps.title: Delegate 3
steps.detail: Flagging when a monitored metric crosses a threshold

sections.name: Catalyst calendar + monitoring plan with triggers
sections.detail: Turn a thesis into a monitoring plan: dated catalysts, the data that leads each one, thresholds that trigger action, and a cadence for re-checking. The difference between having a view and running a position.

outputs.sourcePolicy: Every figure cites the page or filing it was read from; nothing is stated without a source.
